description: This file defines the ExtraFieldBlock class for Drupal's layout builder module, providing a block that renders an extra field from an entity, including methods for building the block, handling placeholders, and access control.

classes.name: ExtraFieldBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a block rendering an extra entity field, with methods for construction, rendering, placeholder replacement, and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity type and field managers, and extracts the field name from the plugin ID.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns default configuration for the block, including label display and formatter settings.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity associated with the block from the context.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the block, including a placeholder and cache metadata.

methods.name: getPreviewFallbackString
methods.description: Generates a fallback string for the field preview, using the field label.

methods.name: replaceFieldPlaceholder
methods.description: Static method that replaces placeholders in the render array with actual field content, merging cache metadata.

methods.name: preRenderBlock
methods.description: Pre-render callback that prevents rendering of empty blocks and preserves cache metadata.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has view access to the entity.
